answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they show a large shift: KL 0.473, top-1 agreement 0.820, sequence agreement 0.219, TV 0.173, and Token-DiFR gap 0.698. All of these are beyond the system-prompted ranges (KL 0.197-0.339, top-1 0.861-0.908, TV 0.108-0.144, DiFR 0.28-0.52), but they are the closest in direction. They are far outside the quantized ranges and also above the fine-tuned ranges (KL 0.081-0.205, top-1 0.900-0.938). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.4 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and quantized (2.2-2.3 is too low), and it fits the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) only weakly. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the main alternative, since a single draw could be an outlier, but the size of the shift favors system-prompted.
